description.text:
One of the eleventh pair of Scarlet & Violet expansions, released on 6 June 2025 together with White Flare. Between them the two packs hold all 156 Pokémon first found in the Unova region, and every Pokémon in them has an Art Rare or Special Art Rare card. Zekrom ex leads Black Bolt, with Kyurem ex, Serperior ex, Meloetta ex, Excadrill ex and Genesect ex and the Supporters N's Plan and Fennel. Each pack held seven cards. The cards are numbered to 86, followed by Art Rare cards of its Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and Zekrom ex as a Black White Rare, drawn in black. In English most of its cards came out in Black Bolt in July 2025.

The Black White Rare (BWR) was a rarity made for these two packs, taking the place of the Ultra Rare. Black Bolt and White Flare were also sold as Expansion Pack Deluxe, a new kind of pack holding 35 cards with one Art Rare certain in each, and their ordinary cards also come in mirror versions patterned with Poké Balls or, more rarely, Master Balls.
